coverageContext: Research model evaluated for neuroblastoma in African American children, with 629 cases and 2,990 controls; European-derived weights explained limited variance in that evaluation. Not an adult cancer model, a diagnosis, an inherited cancer syndrome test or a screening recommendation. EUR reference ranks are withheld because reported evaluation is African ancestry.

The deposited weighted model was evaluated in a European case-control cohort. The publication also reports an unweighted score with different performance; GA does not substitute that model or transfer its metrics. Published study quintiles are not the 1000 Genomes reference ranks. Not a blood test, diagnosis, calibrated probability or screening recommendation.

Research score evaluated for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and other non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes in European participants. Subtypes are not interchangeable. This five-term genetic model is not a diagnosis, tumor classification, absolute-risk estimate, treatment guide or blood-test substitute.

Chinese-population research model evaluated for esophageal cancer in the China Kadoorie Biobank. Reported Cox-model performance includes age, sex, region and ancestry principal components; GA computes only the genetic component. European reference ranks are withheld. Not a diagnosis, personal probability or endoscopy recommendation.

Chinese-population research model evaluated for stomach cancer in the China Kadoorie Biobank. GA preserves the genetic component, not the publication's covariate-adjusted Cox model, infection history or environmental exposures. European reference ranks are withheld. Not a diagnosis, personal probability, infection test or screening recommendation.
